disease_info.message:
Conditions Dr. Deepti commonly treats:

- Nose & sinus: congestion, sinusitis, allergies, polyps, endoscopic sinus surgery
- Ear: hearing loss, infections, ear pain, microscopic ear surgery
- Vertigo: dizziness & balance disorders, Epley's Maneuver
- Throat & voice: swallowing difficulty, voice changes, microlaryngeal surgery
- Head & neck cancer screening:{for early warning signs}
- Nasal Endoscopy, Ear endoscopy,Laryngial Endoscopy - Microlaryngeal surgery 

More info on our Patient Education section: https://drdeeptientdelhi.in/#patient-guidance
